newsitem.title: UK: BOC follows weaker FTSE 100 lower.
newsitem.headline: BOC follows weaker FTSE 100 lower.

text.p: Shares in BOC Group Plc were down 10p to 928p in a generally weak market after the health and industrial gases specialist reported a two percent rise in first quarter pre-tax profits of 102.7 million stg, in line with expectations.
The company said profits would have been seven percent higher if currency effects caused by the strong pound were excluded.
"The figures were bang in the middle of analysts' forecasts but there was nothing too exciting in the trading statement," the head of trading at a large investment bank said.
"On a day like this when the market is suffering a Wall Street hangover, BOC shares have been marked down. I suspect if the Dow had rallied yesterday, the shares would be up a touch," he added.
The FTSE 100 index opened 7.6 points lower at 4,349.8 on Thursday after the Dow industrials average dropped 47 points in New York overnight.
